title: Ultrasmall MoC-supported PtRu clusters with boosted HOR activity and CO tolerance via metal–support interaction
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, 19,2321-2332
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE07453C, Paper
Yaheng Gu, Shaoqing Zhang, Zihao Li, Dezheng Zhang, Jianzhi Liu, Mingda Zhao, Ce Han, Xiue Jiang, Ping Song, Weilin Xu
Ultrasmall MoC-supported PtRu nanoclusters optimize intermediate adsorption and the interfacial hydrogen bond network via metal–support interaction, enabling Pt1Ru2/MoC to exhibit enhanced alkaline HOR performance with high CO tolerance.
